item.title: 'Real excitement' about expansion of Clones Marina
item.description: There is "real excitement" about the expansion of the Marina in Clones. That's according to Hugh Tunney, the manager of the Ulster Canal Stores in Clones. item.title: Investigation launched over Carrick burglary
item.description: Gardai are appealing for information following a burglary in Carrickmacross. The incident took place in the Leons Beg area. According to Gardai, a home was broken into on the eventing of Thursday the 20th of November. Advertisement The incident took place between 5:30pm and 7pm. If you were in the Leons Beg area during that evening and noticed anything suspicious Gardai would like to hear from you.

item.title: Excitement in Mullagh ahead of Cuculainns Ulster Final
item.description: Cuculainns of Cavan will take on Glenullin of Derry this weekend in the Ulster intermediate final. Killian's Lodge owner Michael Farrelly described it as a "huge achievement" for a rural area like Mullagh. Looking ahead to Sunday's final, the local business owner says when people are in good form everyone's spirit is lifted and that's what it's all about. item.title: €50,000 funding boost earmarked for Co. Monaghan businesses
item.description: Fifty thousand euro has been earmarked to support businesses in Co. Monaghan. The funding comes under the Smart Regions Scheme which aims to make regions more business-friendly by investing in infrastructure and networks. It follows Enterprise Minister Peter Burke's announcement of 18 million euro for 40 projects across the country. item.title: Unique pairing in Ulster FAI U18 cup final
item.description: This Saturday evening will see a Northern Sound derby as Cavan Town face Clones Town in the Ulster FAI u18 cup final at Gortakeegan at 6pm. It is a surprise pairing as the competition involved a number of teams from the highly competitive Donegal region who lost out at the semi final stage. item.title: Scotstown GAA campaign to tackle rural isolation
item.description: Scotstown GAA launched its annual Make Your Ceile event, which has been running since its foundation by the late Bernie Sherry. Thi event offers the opportunity to encourage young and old in our communities to pay a visit to a neighbour/family member or those who may be suffering with social isolation. item.title: Local TD slams cuts to LEADER funding
item.description: A local TD has raised concerns about cuts to LEADER funding, and the impact that it will have on the local area. Sinn Féin TD, Cathy Bennett, raised the issue with the Minister for Rural and Community Development, Dara Calleary in the Dáil this week. Deputy Bennett said that the funding plays a vital role in communities, and businesses, especially in Cavan and Monaghan. item.title: Local orchestra to host Christmas concert
item.description: The local Accora Orchestra will host a special Christmas concert this weekend. The talented group represented Ireland this year in the World Music Championships. Advertisement The concert will get underway at 7pm, with mince pies and mulled wine available for ticket holders. item.title: Exhibition launching in Cavan County Museum
item.description: An exhibition on the history of the Protestant Association of Cavan is launching tomorrow. 'A voice of their own: The Protestant Associations of Cavan. Donegal, and Monaghan 1920 - 2016' will be in the Cavan County Museum. The exhibition aims to give a perspective of the history of these associations, and bring an opportunity for renewed dialogue and reconciliation of the past. item.title: Kelly Brady SSE Airtricity/Soccer Writers personality of the year
item.description: World Cup-bound Roberto ‘Pico’ Lopes of Shamrock Rovers and New York-born Kelly Brady scooped the annual SSE Airtricity/Soccer Writers Ireland Personality of the Year awards at Friday’s gala ceremony in Dublin. Lopes, captained Rovers to the SSE Airtricity Men’s Premier Division and FAI Cup double for the first time since 1987, topped the ballot of football media.
